    isConstantArgument(com.articulate.sigma.parsing.SuokifParser.ArgumentContext c)

      public static SuokifVisitor parseFormula(Formula input)
      Parse a single formula and use this SuokifVisitor to process as the cached information for the formula. Copy the formula meta-data to the new formulas.
      Parameters:
      input - the Formula containing SUO-KIF to process
      Returns:
      an instance for accessing a Map that should have a single formula

    • parseSentence

      public static SuokifVisitor parseSentence(String input)
      Parse a single SUO-KIF sentence using thread-local ANTLR instances and the sentence() grammar rule (skips file-level EOF handling). This is the hot-path alternative to parseString(String) for use in ExprToTPTP.translateKifString() where per-call ANTLR object allocation is a measurable bottleneck.
      Parameters:
      input - the KIF sentence string (a single top-level S-expression)
      Returns:
      an instance whose result map contains at most one formula
